name: atc-skills
description: Depth pack for ATC — the ACM SIGOPS Annual Technical Conference (formerly USENIX ATC): broad practical-systems scope, the two-round review with a first-two-pages gate and a 72-hour author response, double-blind HotCRP submission, the Operational Systems Track, artifact badges, shepherding, and ACM Open Access proceedings.

plugins.name: atc-skills
plugins.description: Twelve ATC-specific skills for the ACM SIGOPS Annual Technical Conference (USENIX ATC retired after ATC '25), grounded in the ATC 2027 (Rennes, deadline 19 January 2027) SIGOPS call for papers, the ATC 2026 call, the USENIX sunset record, and dblp.
